data.name: Jenti
data.gender_notes: Jenti is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Jaya' meaning 'victory' and 'Anti' meaning 'near', Jenti refers to the goddess of wealth and prosperity who is believed to be near or brings victory in material pursuits. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as carrying a lotus and riding a lion. The name Jenti carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jenti usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of inner wealth and prosperity.
data.etymology: Jenti belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of wealth and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jenti total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
